fact: The national survey on ICT access and use, fielded 29 April to 17 May 2024 among 4,100 households, found 53% in rural areas in possession of a simple mobile phone, with urban possession of Android phones more than three times the rural rate (no national all-phone figure or age base is stated).
title: Présentation et validation du rapport de l’enquête nationale sur l’accès et l’utilisation des TIC au Burundi
